items.title: US ground stop lifted as airlines restart flights
items.snippet: The US ground stop ended, allowing airlines to restart departures after communications problems disrupted air traffic control. However, the resumption of flights did not immediately restore airline schedules. The Federal Aviation Administration said the nationwide restriction followed communications issues affecting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers.

items.title: Ireland extends visa waiver programme for Indians
items.snippet: Ireland has extended its Short-Stay Visa Waiver Programme until December 31, 2026, allowing eligible Indian nationals to visit the country without obtaining a separate Irish visa, provided they hold and have used a qualifying UK short-stay visa. The programme, which was earlier scheduled to end on October 31, covers nationals from countries across Asia, Europe, the Middle East and South America.

items.title: Kerzner Announces First Thailand Resort in Chiang Mai
items.snippet: Kerzner International Holdings Limited (Kerzner), a global developer and operator of destination resorts, ultra-luxury hotels, residences and hospitality experiences, has announced Vana Som Botanical Resort in Mae Rim, Chiang Mai.

items.title: Scotch whisky import dispute likely to be resolved 'very soon': Commerce secretary Rajesh Agrawal
items.snippet: The government is hopeful of resolving the ongoing Scotch whisky import shipment issue within the next few days, with the Department of Revenue working to address concerns related to product classification, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said on Friday.

items.title: Municipal Corporation of Delhi draws up stricter inspection norms for eateries, may issue sealing notices
items.snippet: In a bid to elevate food safety standards, the MCD has launched stricter inspection protocols for eateries across the city. Inspections will assess hygiene practices, the quality of water used, and the sources of food supplies. Establishments that do not conform to these standards could face penalties or even closure.

items.title: Jungle Camps India expands portfolio with launch of Kuno Jungle Camp in Madhya Pradesh
items.snippet: Jungle Camps India Limited has announced the launch of Kuno Jungle Camp in Madhya Pradesh, expanding its portfolio to six wildlife lodges. Located in Sheopur district near Kuno National Park, the property was formerly known as The Palpur Fort.

items.title: The Retail Opportunity Hotels Keep Missing
items.snippet: Founders of Basecamp Resorts and Nomada Hotel Group share lessons on building profitable hotel retail programs, from product curation and merchandising to vendor strategy and proprietary branding.

items.title: What Caused the FAA Shutdown That Grounded U.S. Flights?
items.snippet: A nationwide FAA ground stop disrupted thousands of flights after telecommunications maintenance triggered network failures, prompting an investigation into L3Harris equipment, mounting weekend cancellations and renewed demands for modernization funding.

items.title: FAA Lifts 4-Hour Nationwide Ground Stop; Disruptions to Last Into Weekend
items.snippet: Skift Take: This is only the third nationwide ground stop in 25 years. The last one, during a 2023 system outage, lasted about two hours. The Federal Aviation Administration ended a nationwide ground stop Friday night more than four hours after a communication issue affected the Air Route Traffic Control Centers, the high-altitude air traffic control facilities that manage flights between airports.

items.title: Aspri Spirits, Flor de Caña Name Top 10 India Finalists for Sustainable Cocktail Challenge
items.snippet: Now in its 6th edition, and coinciding with Flor de Caña’s 135th anniversary, the Flor de Caña Sustainable Cocktail Challenge is a global celebration of sustainability that inspires, promotes and recognizes the world’s most talented mixologists.
